correctness.rationale: Connected graph Laplacian conservation implies a period-two return has uniform total firing count in {0,1,2}; primitive return forces exactly one firing per vertex. For each time-zero firing split p,q, necessary and sufficient chip intervals contribute (b−q)^p q^(a−p)(a−p)^q p^(b−q); every state has a unique split. Their weighted sum equals a^b b^a trace(K_ab K_ba), where the binomial transition composition preserves degree filtration and has eigenvalues (a)_k(b)_k/(a^k b^k), remaining eigenvalues zero when a>b. Gaussian dominated sums at scale √[ab/(a+b)] yield the unrestricted joint asymptotic. Fresh exhaustive actual two-step updates for nine small bicliques and exact phase-vs-trace tests for 196 parameter pairs succeeded; finite enumeration is corroboration only.

value.rationale: A closed exact all-size count and joint Gaussian asymptotic for recurrent period-two states answer a natural dynamical enumeration question, separating initial periodic states from long basins and eventually-periodic mass regions. The binomial trace diagonalization exposes underlying algebra beyond a raw state count.

final_claim: For labelled K_{a,b} with a,b≥1, the number of primitive period-two orbits is a^b b^a/2 times Σ_{k=0}^{min(a,b)} (a)_k(b)_k/(a^k b^k), and as min(a,b)→∞ it is asymptotic to a^b b^a√(πab/[8(a+b)]). Period-two initial states, not basins or other periods.
limitations: Other periods and eventual-cycle basins are outside scope; finite simulations are not the unrestricted proof.
